general_comment: Mutation testing config for the frontend.
samd_comment: SaMD requires demonstrable verification (IEC 62304 5.7). Mutation score is the proof that tests assert behavior, not just render.
ignoreStatic_comment: Do NOT mutate static constants (literals computed once at module load). Mutating them wastes the bulk of the run on unreachable/equivalent mutants.
incremental_comment: Reuse prior results; only re-test mutants in changed files. Keep .stryker-tmp/incremental.json out of source control churn but cached in CI.
coverageAnalysis_comment: perTest maps each test to the code it covers so only relevant tests run per mutant. Largest single speedup.
timeouts_comment: The full suite needs a generous dry-run window or it aborts before the baseline finishes.
concurrency_comment: Tune to (nproc - 4) on the runner. Comment left for the operator; uncomment to pin.
thresholds_comment: break is the CI gate: score below it fails the build. high/low only color the report. One global break fits this skeleton; if your project splits critical modules (>=90) from the rest (>=75, .claude/rules/testing.md), use two configs.
